description: This satellite image depicts the Gironde Estuary in France, captured by Spot 5 on 2011-08-01. The imagery uses a 1/2/3 band combination, resulting in a false-colour composite where the main river channels and associated wetlands or vegetation appear in distinct red and dark reddish-brown tones. These channels branch out, forming a delta-like pattern as they discharge into a larger, dark blue body of water, likely the Atlantic Ocean or a bay. The surrounding land shows varying textures and shades of reddish-brown and tan, representing different land cover types. The image has a resolution of 2.5 metres. Credit: CNES 2011©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image.
